0.name: R
0.text: Oh, to be back in this wretched place...

2.name: R
2.text: But how could I refuse meeting such a charming public worker such as yourself again?

3.name: R
3.text: I did promise I would come back with some more interesting topics, didn't I?

4.name: R
4.text: Come on then, make me some coffee.

5.name: R
5.text: But not the same as the last time, oh no...

6.name: R
6.text: Stagnation is worse than death, girl. Never stay at one single place for too long, I say.

7.name: R
7.text: Now, please, make me a milky drink which fuels the brain, but also foams creamy white deliciousness, much like an italian delicacy.
